rationale: The assistant immediately told the customer to stop resetting the trip, unplug the machine and avoid removing panels, then asked the single most discriminating question (trip at start vs minutes into heating). On the customer's answer it correctly identified the heater element as the leading suspect with appropriate hedging ('points very strongly', 'less likely alternatives'), and escalated to an appliance engineer for an insulation test rather than naming a part. Minor gaps: it never asked which device trips (RCD vs MCB), whether it trips on another circuit, or for the full model number, and the stop-use text was repeated verbatim in the second turn.
